sub_graphs.title: Prague: EOA Delegation Authorization Lifecycle (EIP-7702)
sub_graphs.description: Models the full lifecycle of setting up code delegation from an EOA to another address

nodes.label: SET_CODE Transaction Received
nodes.description: A type 0x05 transaction with authorization list has been received

nodes.label: Process Authorization List
nodes.description: Iterate through each authorization in the transaction

nodes.label: Validate Chain ID
nodes.description: Check authorization chain_id matches current chain or is 0 (universal)

nodes.label: Validate Nonce Bounds
nodes.description: Verify authorization nonce is less than U64.MAX

nodes.label: Recover Authority Address
nodes.description: Recover signer address from authorization signature using ECDSA

nodes.label: Validate Account Nonce Match
nodes.description: Verify authority account's current nonce matches authorization nonce

nodes.label: Validate Existing Code
nodes.description: Check account has empty code or valid existing delegation

nodes.label: Set Delegation Code
nodes.description: Set account code to 0xef0100 + target_address

nodes.label: Increment Authority Nonce
nodes.description: Increment the authority account's nonce by 1

nodes.label: Delegation Active
nodes.description: EOA now delegates code execution to target address

nodes.label: Authorization Skipped
nodes.description: Authorization failed validation, skipped without error

edges.label: Chain ID mismatch and not universal

external_entities.name: Transaction Submitter
external_entities.description: External user or wallet submitting SET_CODE transaction with authorizations

sub_graphs.title: Prague: EOA Delegation Signature Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the cryptographic validation of authorization signatures for EOA delegation

nodes.label: Authorization Received
nodes.description: An authorization tuple (chain_id, address, nonce, y_parity, r, s) is being processed

nodes.label: Validate Y Parity
nodes.description: Check y_parity is exactly 0 or 1

nodes.label: Validate R Value Range
nodes.description: Verify r is within secp256k1 curve order (0 < r < n)

nodes.label: Validate S Value Range
nodes.description: Verify s is within secp256k1 curve order (0 < s < n)

nodes.label: Compute Signing Hash
nodes.description: Compute keccak256(0x05 || RLP(chain_id, address, nonce))

nodes.label: ECDSA Recover
nodes.description: Recover public key and derive address from signature

nodes.label: Authority Address Recovered
nodes.description: The address that signed the authorization has been recovered

nodes.label: Invalid Signature Error
nodes.description: Signature validation failed, InvalidSignatureError raised

sub_graphs.title: Prague: EOA Delegation Gas Accounting
sub_graphs.description: Models the gas cost calculations for delegation operations including warm/cold access

nodes.label: Delegation Access Requested
nodes.description: Code execution needs to access a potentially delegated address

nodes.label: Check Accessed Addresses
nodes.description: Determine if address is in warm accessed_addresses set

nodes.label: Address Warm
nodes.description: Address was previously accessed, warm cost applies

nodes.label: Address Cold
nodes.description: First access to address, cold cost applies

nodes.label: Compute Access Gas Cost
nodes.description: Calculate gas based on warm (100) or cold (2600) access

nodes.label: Update Accessed Addresses
nodes.description: Add address to accessed_addresses set

nodes.label: Access Complete
nodes.description: Delegation target retrieved with appropriate gas charged

sub_graphs.title: Prague: Delegation Code Validity Check
sub_graphs.description: Models the security checks for validating delegation code format

nodes.label: Code Received for Validation
nodes.description: Bytecode needs to be checked for valid delegation format

nodes.label: Check Code Length
nodes.description: Verify code is exactly 23 bytes (EOA_DELEGATED_CODE_LENGTH)

nodes.label: Check Delegation Marker
nodes.description: Verify code starts with 0xef0100 (EOA_DELEGATION_MARKER)

nodes.label: Extract Target Address
nodes.description: Extract 20-byte address after 3-byte marker

nodes.label: Valid Delegation Code
nodes.description: Code is valid delegation, target address extracted

nodes.label: Invalid/Non-Delegation Code
nodes.description: Code is not a valid delegation format

ambiguities.text: The behavior when NULL_ADDRESS (0x0000...0000) is used as the delegation target is described as 'clears delegation' but the exact resulting code state is ambiguous
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume setting delegation to NULL_ADDRESS results in empty code (length 0), effectively revoking delegation.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not clarify behavior when multiple authorizations for the same authority exist in a single transaction
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume authorizations are processed in order, so later authorizations for the same address will fail nonce check due to prior increment.

ambiguities.text: The phrase 'valid delegation' is used but it's unclear if a delegation to a non-existent contract address is valid
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume any 20-byte address is valid as delegation target, including EOAs and non-existent accounts.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot forge ECDSA signatures to create unauthorized delegations
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Attackers could hijack EOAs by forging delegation authorizations, redirecting all calls to malicious code

implicit_assumptions.description: The delegation target contract is trusted by the EOA owner at the time of authorization
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Users could delegate to malicious contracts that steal funds or perform unauthorized actions

implicit_assumptions.description: The secp256k1 curve parameters used for ECDSA are correct and consistent across all implementations
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Different curve parameters could cause signature validation discrepancies between nodes

implicit_assumptions.description: Users understand that delegating code changes their EOA's behavior for all future transactions
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Users may unintentionally lock themselves out or enable unauthorized actions

implicit_assumptions.description: The 0xef0100 marker (3 bytes) uniquely identifies delegation code and cannot conflict with valid EVM bytecode
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Legitimate contracts starting with this prefix would be misinterpreted as delegations
